note: Both sets cover the same four facts (KP, KI, KD at θ = 0º and ζφ = 0.7) and both contain duplicated claims, but Set A's duplicates are at least accurate and consistently bound to the blade-pitch controller. Set B includes a misbound claim where ζφ is placed in the conditions field of the damping-ratio claim rather than as the attribute, and it also labels the attribute vaguely as 'damping ratio' in one entry. Neither set captures the gain-correction factor GK(θ) = 1/(1+θ/θK) or the use of the previous time step's blade-pitch angle, so both are incomplete, but Set A introduces no misreadings while Set B does.
